rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id := '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET	@send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET	@b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_tcm4(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  p_q1 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	p_q2 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	p_q3 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	p_q4 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
  ofcp_q1 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	ofcp_q2 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	ofcp_q3 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	ofcp_q4 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
  v_q1 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	v_q2 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	v_q3 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	v_q4 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
  ofcv_q1 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	ofcv_q2 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	ofcv_q3 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	ofcv_q4 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_tcm4 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);
INSERT IGNORE INTO s_tcm4
(
SELECT @id,h.hoscode ,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543
,SUM(t.total_pt_q1) ,SUM(t.total_pt_q2) ,SUM(t.total_pt_q3) ,SUM(t.total_pt_q4) 

,SUM(IF(t.instype IN('OFC'),t.total_pt_q1,0)),SUM(IF(t.instype IN('OFC'),t.total_pt_q2,0)),SUM(IF(t.instype IN('OFC'),t.total_pt_q3,0)),SUM(IF(t.instype IN('OFC'),t.total_pt_q4,0))

,SUM(t.total_q1) ,SUM(t.total_q2) ,SUM(t.total_q3) ,SUM(t.total_q4) 

,SUM(IF(t.instype IN('OFC'),t.total_q1,0)),SUM(IF(t.instype IN('OFC'),t.total_q2,0)),SUM(IF(t.instype IN('OFC'),t.total_q3,0)),SUM(IF(t.instype IN('OFC'),t.total_q4,0))

FROM
t_tcm1 t INNER JOIN chospital h ON t.hospcode=h.hoscode AND h.provcode IN(@prov_c)
WHERE year_rep=@b_year
GROUP BY t.hospcode
);

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("p_q1"+"p_q2"+"p_q3"+"p_q4") AS p, SUM("ofcp_q1"+"ofcp_q2"+"ofcp_q3"+"ofcp_q4") AS ofcp, SUM("v_q1"+"v_q2"+"v_q3"+"v_q4") AS v, SUM("ofcv_q1"+"ofcv_q2"+"ofcv_q3"+"ofcv_q4") AS ofcv, SUM("p_q1") AS "p_q1", SUM("p_q2") AS "p_q2", SUM("p_q3") AS "p_q3", SUM("p_q4") AS "p_q4", SUM("ofcp_q1") AS "ofcp_q1", SUM("ofcp_q2") AS "ofcp_q2", SUM("ofcp_q3") AS "ofcp_q3", SUM("ofcp_q4") AS "ofcp_q4", SUM("v_q1") AS "v_q1", SUM("v_q2") AS "v_q2", SUM("v_q3") AS "v_q3", SUM("v_q4") AS "v_q4", SUM("ofcv_q1") AS "ofcv_q1", SUM("ofcv_q2") AS "ofcv_q2", SUM("ofcv_q3") AS "ofcv_q3", SUM("ofcv_q4") AS "ofcv_q4" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

service_plan.query: SELECT h.splevel as a_code ,h.splevel as a_name ,  SUM(p_q1+p_q2+p_q3+p_q4) AS p, SUM(ofcp_q1+ofcp_q2+ofcp_q3+ofcp_q4) AS ofcp, SUM(v_q1+v_q2+v_q3+v_q4) AS v, SUM(ofcv_q1+ofcv_q2+ofcv_q3+ofcv_q4) AS ofcv,  SUM(p_q1) AS p_q1, SUM(p_q2) AS p_q2, SUM(p_q3) AS p_q3, SUM(p_q4) AS p_q4, SUM(ofcp_q1) AS ofcp_q1, SUM(ofcp_q2) AS ofcp_q2, SUM(ofcp_q3) AS ofcp_q3, SUM(ofcp_q4) AS ofcp_q4, SUM(v_q1) AS v_q1, SUM(v_q2) AS v_q2, SUM(v_q3) AS v_q3, SUM(v_q4) AS v_q4, SUM(ofcv_q1) AS ofcv_q1, SUM(ofcv_q2) AS ofcv_q2, SUM(ofcv_q3) AS ofcv_q3, SUM(ofcv_q4) AS ofcv_q4 FROM (SELECT * FROM ccmihosp WHERE byear={{YEAR}}) as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hcode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} JOIN chospital as c ON c.hoscode = h.hcode WHERE (c.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (c.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (c.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (c.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (c.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (c.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (c.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (c.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (h.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CAST(regbed AS DECIMAL) DESC
